title: Provide / Inject: Dependency Injection
description: Pass data deep down the component tree without prop drilling.

slides.title: The Problem: Prop Drilling
slides.content:
# Prop Drilling

When a deeply nested component needs data from a distant ancestor, you might end up passing props through many intermediate components that don't need them.

```html
<Grandparent :theme="theme">
  <Parent :theme="theme">
    <Child :theme="theme">
      <DeepChild />
    </Child>
  </Parent>
</Grandparent>
```

This is verbose and makes refactoring painful.

options.text: Avoiding prop drilling for deeply nested components
